cases.title: Sales by price bracket
cases.question: Break down apartment sales in JVC over the last 90 days into under AED 1 million, AED 1–2 million, and above AED 2 million. Show transaction counts and each bracket’s market share.

cases.title: Building activity
cases.question: Which buildings in Business Bay recorded the most two-bedroom sales last quarter? Show transaction count, median price, and median price per sqft.

cases.title: Typical transaction range
cases.question: What price range contains the middle 50% of one-bedroom apartment sales in Downtown Dubai over the last six months?

cases.title: New leases versus renewals
cases.question: Compare median annual rents for new and renewed two-bedroom contracts in JLT over the last 90 days. Show the percentage difference and sample sizes.

cases.title: Rental normalization
cases.question: Show rental contracts in Dubai Marina with terms longer than one year. Compare their total contract amounts with annualized rents.

cases.title: Rental trends

cases.title: Supply concentration
cases.question: Which developers account for the largest share of units scheduled for delivery in Dubai South over the next two years?

cases.title: Uncertain delivery dates

cases.title: Listing inventory

cases.title: Rental-income screening

cases.title: Landlord rental appraisal report

cases.title: Seller competition report

cases.title: Monthly area report
cases.question: Create a one-page Business Bay market report for my clients covering last month’s sales activity, achieved prices, registered rents, current listing inventory, and upcoming deliveries. Highlight changes from the previous month.

cases.title: Off-plan comparison report
cases.question: Prepare a client report comparing [Project A], [Project B], and [Project C]. Include unit prices and sizes, payment plans, construction progress, scheduled delivery, nearby achieved prices, and missing information that needs verification.
